compatabilityOptions.comment: Options to help improve the behaviour of Bits 'n' Bobs alongside other mods. (Opt-in)

suppressExternalWoodenCogwheels.comment: Suppresses wooden cogwheels from other mods in favour of Bits 'n' Bobs' behaviour system. Intended for Create: Encased but may work with other mods with proper tags.

featureFlags.comment: Feature flags to enable or disable certain features of the mod.

flangedChainDrives.comment: Ability for the player to create chain drives using the flanged gear cogwheels.

chainPulley.comment: Availability of the Chain Pulley block.

flywheelBearing.comment: Availability of the Flywheel Bearing block.

weatheredGirder.comment: Availability of the weathered girder block.

girderStrut.comment: Availability of the girder strut blocks.

largeNixieTube.comment: Availability of Large Nixie Tube block.

brassLamp.comment: Availability of the Brass Lamp block. (Legacy)

tiles.comment: Availability of the tile decoration blocks.

industrialGrating.comment: Availability of the industrial grating blocks.

industrialTruss.comment: Availability of the industrial truss blocks.

cogwheelChainCarriage.comment: Availability of the Cogwheel Chain Carriage block.

cableGirderStrut.comment: Availability of the Cable Girder Strut block.

weatheredMetalBracket.comment: Availability of the Weathered Metal Bracket block.

industrialIronEncasing.comment: Availability of the Industrial Iron encased block variants.

weatheredIronEncasing.comment: Availability of the Weathered Iron encased block variants.

undedicatedCogwheelChainDrives.comment: Ability for the player to create chain drives on components that are not dedicated for chains (i.e. not flanged)
